title: Support LLVM21 + blackwell family
body: The latest JAX does not support LLVM 21 or the Spark, Thor, and GB300 platforms. I am building the CUDA 13 plugin for Linux aarch64 with Blackwell-family compute capabilities, but the build reports that capabilities such as sm_103 or sm_110 are unsupported.

symptoms_visible: My Linux aarch64 CUDA 13 build of the latest JAX reports that Blackwell-family capabilities such as sm_103 or sm_110 are unsupported.
I cannot build JAX for Spark, Thor, and GB300 with LLVM 21.
N0.label: N0 LLVM21 and Blackwell build failure reported

symptoms_visible: The CUDA plugin build selects Clang even though I expected NVCC, then reports that requested Blackwell compute capabilities are unsupported.
N1.label: N1 original Jetson build command collected

symptoms_visible: After removing the clang_path build argument, removing LLVM 20, or trying to force NVCC, the CUDA plugin build still selects Clang or reports sm_103 and sm_110 as unsupported.
N1_x.label: N1_x manual compiler forcing aftermath

symptoms_visible: The aarch64 CUDA 13 JAX build completes successfully after adding the ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13 Bazel configuration, but this working setup requires LLVM 18.
N2.label: N2 aarch64 CUDA configuration works with LLVM18

symptoms_visible: With clang_path set to LLVM 21 and ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13 enabled, my build from JAX main stops while fetching llvm_linux_aarch64 and prints: 'Ensure LLVM 21 support is added prior to use. Supported versions: 18, 20'.
N3_x.label: N3_x LLVM21 retry rejected by aarch64 toolchain

symptoms_visible: My JAX build still rejects LLVM 21 on Linux aarch64 even though LLVM 21 support is available for the x86 toolchain.
N4.label: N4 missing Linux aarch64 LLVM21 support identified

symptoms_visible: After taking the latest JAX main branch, my Linux aarch64 CUDA build works with LLVM 21.
N_terminal.label: terminal LLVM21 aarch64 build confirmed working

question_patterns: Could you share the complete command or build script that produces this error?
Which JAX build flags, compiler path, CUDA version, and compute capabilities are you passing?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I am building from JAX main with the Jetson aarch64 build script. It requests CUDA 13.0, cuDNN 9.12, sm_87, sm_89, sm_90, sm_100, sm_103, sm_110, sm_120 and sm_121, and sets clang_path to /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang. The final command builds the jaxlib, jax-cuda-plugin and jax-cuda-pjrt wheels.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I am installing an official prebuilt x86_64 wheel and am not invoking Bazel or building for aarch64.
The same script uses a different output directory, but the compiler, CUDA version, architecture and compute-capability flags are unchanged.

edges.comment: From c3-c4, describing the reporter's Jetson-container build. The full script establishes that this is a Linux aarch64 CUDA 13 source build and exposes the missing aarch64 CI configuration.

solution.intent: Try to make the build use NVCC by removing the explicit Clang path, removing the installed LLVM package, or otherwise forcing the CUDA compiler selection.
solution.concrete_example: Remove --clang_path, uninstall LLVM 20, or force the cuda_compiler setting to nvcc and rerun the plugin build.

edges.comment: Reporter c2 and c4: removing clang_path, removing LLVM 20 and forcing NVCC were actually tried, but the build continued to select Clang or reject the requested capabilities.

solution.intent: Use JAX's Linux aarch64 CUDA 13 Bazel configuration so the source build selects the intended ARM64 CUDA toolchain.
solution.concrete_example: Add --bazel_options=--config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13 to BUILD_FLAGS before running build.py. In the reporter's initial successful setup, LLVM 18 was required.

edges.comment: Participant2 c14 proposed the aarch64 CUDA 13 CI config after reproducing the toolchain-selection issue. Reporter c16-c17 confirmed that it built successfully, with LLVM 18 mandatory at that time.

solution.intent: Recover from the unsuccessful manual compiler changes by selecting JAX's complete Linux aarch64 CUDA 13 Bazel configuration.
solution.concrete_example: Restore a supported compiler setup and add --bazel_options=--config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13 to BUILD_FLAGS; the reporter's build then completes with LLVM 18.

edges.comment: Recovery edge for the same c14-c17 resolution after the reporter's failed compiler-forcing attempts.

solution.intent: Retry the otherwise working aarch64 CUDA 13 build after changing clang_path to LLVM 21, based only on upstream LLVM 21 compatibility announcements.
solution.concrete_example: Change clang_path to /usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang while retaining --config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13, then build JAX main.

edges.comment: Reporter c19-c20 retried with LLVM 21 after upstream toolchain and OpenXLA support appeared. The attempt failed because the JAX toolchain dependency still explicitly supported only versions 18 and 20 for this path.

question_patterns: Can you check whether the toolchain repository has an LLVM 21 artifact for the target architecture?
Does the same toolchain definition include LLVM 21 for Linux aarch64, or only for another architecture?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I found the problem: LLVM 21 is present for x86, but not for Linux aarch64.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: LLVM 21 is already listed with valid artifacts for Linux aarch64, and the fetch succeeds; the failure happens later while compiling JAX C++ sources.
The Linux aarch64 entry exists but its download mirror metadata is incomplete.

question_patterns: What is missing from the Linux aarch64 LLVM 21 toolchain entry?
Can you identify whether the aarch64 download or mirror metadata needs to be added?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The Linux aarch64 LLVM 21 mirror entry and its SHA256 need to be added. I prepared a toolchain change and tested LLVM 21.1.5 locally.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The wheel output directory is /opt/jax/wheels instead of the directory used by the earlier script.

edges.comment: Reporter c24-c27 identified the architecture-specific gap and proposed mirror metadata. The maintainer noted that the initial stub needed additional Linux aarch64 work, so the local experiment is not treated as final verification of the landed JAX fix.

solution.intent: Add complete Linux aarch64 LLVM 21 support to the shared ML toolchain, update JAX to consume that support, then ask the reporter to rebuild from a JAX main revision containing the changes.
solution.concrete_example: Add the Linux aarch64 LLVM 21 artifact and mirror metadata to the toolchain, submit the corresponding JAX toolchain update, then have the reporter take the latest main branch and rerun the same aarch64 CUDA 13 build.
solution.inference_hint: The raw error proves that the fetched rules_ml_toolchain accepts only LLVM 18 and 20, while the reporter's inspection shows that LLVM 21 was missing specifically for Linux aarch64. Maintainers concluded that both the shared toolchain support and JAX's consumption of the updated toolchain had to land before the reporter's build could work.

edges.comment: Participant2 c26-c35 completed the Linux aarch64 toolchain work and submitted the corresponding JAX changes. The reporter then rebuilt from latest main and personally confirmed in c37 that it worked.

satisfaction_conditions: Must distinguish the two toolchain issues: the initial build needed JAX's ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13 Bazel configuration, while the later LLVM 21 failure occurred because the shared toolchain lacked complete LLVM 21 support and artifact metadata for Linux aarch64.

The diagnosis must be grounded in the reporter's exact error stating that only LLVM 18 and 20 were supported and in the architecture check showing LLVM 21 was available for x86 but missing for Linux aarch64.
The lasting fix must add Linux aarch64 LLVM 21 support to the shared toolchain and update JAX to consume it; merely changing clang_path or relying on upstream OpenXLA compatibility is insufficient.
Must not recommend only removing the Clang path, uninstalling LLVM, or forcing NVCC, because those attempts did not resolve the reporter's build.
Must ask the reporter to rebuild from a JAX main revision containing the toolchain changes and must not declare resolution until the reporter confirms that the LLVM 21 aarch64 build works.

persona_hint.experience_level: Experienced Jetson container maintainer who builds JAX and its CUDA plugin from source, edits Bazel flags, tests toolchain artifacts, and can prepare infrastructure pull requests.
persona_hint.communication_style: Direct, informal, and persistent; shares complete shell scripts and raw errors, quickly tests proposed changes, and follows up until support is merged and verified.
